craft_claim: Abstract ideas become tractable when the voice carries them on a concrete conceptual metaphor or a compact thought-experiment image.

supporting_evidence.location: Metaphors We Live By, chs. 1-2 and 5
supporting_evidence.note: Argues that metaphor is a fundamental mechanism of thought by which concrete physical and social experience structures abstract domains; the mechanism is widely influential though partly contested, so the claim is scoped to the mechanism.

supporting_evidence.location: 'On the Equality of Things', the Butterfly Dream passage
supporting_evidence.note: A brief dream image is made to carry an abstract problem about the reality of waking and the stability of the self.

supporting_evidence.location: The Zhuangzi, parables and transformation imagery
supporting_evidence.note: Confirms the text's use of story, parable and transformation imagery to embody claims rather than state them.

scope: Essay, poetry, contemplative fiction and conceptual copy.
exceptions: A metaphor that decorates without mapping onto the argument becomes ornament; the vehicle must carry structure the reader can extend.
